name: EMDB_get_structure
description: Get 3D electron microscopy (EM) structure data from the Electron Microscopy Data Bank (EMDB). Returns cryo-EM structure metadata including resolution (in Ångströms), imaging method, organism, molecule details, voxel dimensions, map download URLs, and cross-references to PDB entries. Use this for structural biology research, comparing protein conformations, drug design, and downloading electron density maps for visualization or model fitting.

name: EMDB_search_structures
description: Search EMDB through the official EBI Search emdb domain with exact hitCount and start/rows pagination. The former /emdb/api/search path currently returns HTTP 200 empty arrays for valid common queries. Continue with metadata.next_start; use EMDB_get_structure on returned IDs for full archive metadata.

query.description: Search query for EMDB structures. Examples: 'ribosome', 'spike protein', 'SARS-CoV-2', 'amyloid', 'ion channel'. Searches titles, descriptions, and molecule names.

start.description: Zero-based EBI Search offset. Continue with metadata.next_start.

return_schema.description: EBI Search envelope with exact hitCount and an EMDB entry page.

items.description: One entry. This upstream returns such a list as scalars in some replies and as full records in others, so an element can be either.

name: EMDB_get_publications
description: Get publication information for an EMDB entry including journal articles, preprints, and citations that describe the cryo-EM structure. Returns publication titles, authors, journals, DOIs, PubMed IDs, and abstracts. Use this to find the research papers associated with a structure, understand experimental context, or cite the original work. Use EMDB ID from EMDB_search_structures or EMDB_get_structure.

emdb_id.description: EMDB structure identifier in format 'EMD-####' (e.g., 'EMD-1234', 'EMD-0001'). Find IDs via EMDB search or from publications.

return_schema.description: Publications associated with the EMDB entry.

items.description: One entry. This upstream returns such a list as scalars in some replies and as full records in others, so an element can be either.

name: EMDB_get_map_info
description: Get detailed electron density map information for an EMDB entry including map statistics, contour levels, pixel spacing, dimensions, symmetry, and map file download URLs. Returns technical details essential for map visualization, model fitting, and computational analysis. Use this to prepare for structure visualization in tools like ChimeraX, Coot, or PyMOL.

emdb_id.description: EMDB structure identifier in format 'EMD-####' (e.g., 'EMD-1234', 'EMD-0001'). Find IDs via EMDB search or from publications.

return_schema.description: Electron density map details and statistics.

map.description: The EM map itself: format, size in kbytes, file name, symmetry and the contour level. Without the contour level a map cannot be rendered as the depositors saw it.

name: EMDB_get_sample_info
description: Get detailed sample preparation information for an EMDB entry including macromolecular composition, organism source, expression system, molecular weight, oligomeric state, and ligands. Returns biological context essential for understanding the structure's physiological relevance, complex assembly, and binding partners. Use this to understand sample preparation before structural analysis.

name: EMDB_get_imaging_info
description: Get electron microscopy imaging parameters for an EMDB entry including microscope model, detector type, acceleration voltage, dose rate, total electron dose, defocus range, and data collection strategy. Returns technical details essential for understanding data quality, reproducing experiments, and optimizing imaging protocols. Use this to assess data collection quality or design similar experiments.

emdb_id.description: EMDB structure identifier in format 'EMD-####' (e.g., 'EMD-1234', 'EMD-0001'). Find IDs via EMDB search or from publications.

return_schema.description: Microscopy imaging parameters and data collection details.

imaging.description: How it was imaged, starting with base_microscopy_type - which separates single-particle from tomography, and so what the map can be used for.

name: EMDB_get_validation
description: Get validation analysis results for an EMDB entry including FSC curves, resolution estimates, map-model correlation, B-factors, geometry validation, and quality scores. Returns comprehensive quality metrics essential for assessing structure reliability, identifying artifacts, and comparing with other structures. Use this to evaluate data quality before using a structure for drug design or mechanistic studies.

emdb_id.description: EMDB structure identifier in format 'EMD-####' (e.g., 'EMD-1234', 'EMD-0001'). Find IDs via EMDB search or from publications.

return_schema.description: Validation metrics keyed by EMDB ID (e.g., {'1234': {...}}).

resolution.description: The reported resolution of the map.

value.description: Resolution in angstroms, e.g. 14.5. The AUTHOR's claim, not an independent measurement -- rotationally_averaged_power_spectrum is the check on it.

recommended_contour_level.description: The contour level the depositor recommends for viewing. Displaying a map at the wrong contour makes features appear or vanish.

recl.description: The level itself, e.g. 611.0, in the map's own density units.

sigma.description: The same level in standard deviations above the mean, e.g. 0.309. This is the form that is comparable BETWEEN maps; the raw level is not.

predicated_contour_level.description: A contour level EMDB computes from the density itself, for comparison with the depositor's.

primary.description: The computed level and what it encloses.

value.description: The level, e.g. 2546.5. A large gap from recommended_contour_level.recl is worth looking at.

volume.description: The volume enclosed at that level.

density_distribution.description: The map's density histogram -- what both contour levels are chosen against.

mode.description: The modal density, e.g. -87.35. For a well-formed map this is the solvent peak, so a mode far from zero means the map is not zero-centred.

y.description: Counts in each bin, positionally parallel to `x`.

volume_estimate.description: Enclosed volume as a function of contour level -- the curve the contour choice is made on.

estvolume.description: Estimated volume at the recommended contour, e.g. 88060. Compare with the expected molecular volume: far too large means the contour is too low.

volume.description: The enclosed volume at each of those levels, positionally parallel to `level`.

central_slice.description: The central slice of the map, as images and as indices.

indices.description: The slice index taken on each axis, as {x, y, z}.

original.description: The slice image at the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: The same slice contrast-scaled for viewing. Features visible here and not in `original` are a product of the scaling. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

largest_variance_slice.description: The slice with the most variation -- where the structure is, which is not always the centre. Carries the same {indices, original, scaled} shape as central_slice when rendered.

indices.description: The slice index on each axis.

original.description: The slice image. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: The contrast-scaled slice image. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

rotationally_averaged_power_spectrum.description: The map's power as a function of spatial frequency. It falls away past the real resolution, so plotted against `resolution.value` it is the independent check on the claimed resolution.

y.description: Power at each of those frequencies, positionally parallel to `x`.

symmetry.description: The symmetry imposed during reconstruction. Imposed symmetry the specimen does not have averages real asymmetry away, which no resolution figure will reveal.

symmetry_info.description: What symmetry was applied, or true/false when only its presence is recorded.

map_surface.description: Rendered surface of the map at the recommended contour. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_projection.description: Orthogonal projection through the map. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_max.description: Maximum-value projection. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_min.description: Minimum-value projection. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_median.description: Median projection. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_std.description: Standard-deviation projection -- where the map varies most. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_glow_projection.description: Glow-rendered projection. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_glow_max.description: Glow-rendered maximum projection. Rendered per axis and at two contrasts: {original: {x,y,z}, scaled: {x,y,z}}.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

orthogonal_glow_std.description: Glow-rendered standard-deviation image, with EMDB's own saturation check beside it.

original.description: At the map's own contrast. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

scaled.description: Contrast-scaled for viewing. Returned per AXIS as {x, y, z}, not as a single file.

green_percentage.description: How much of each rendered view is saturated green, per axis. A high percentage means the glow rendering is clipping, so the image understates the real variation.

percentage.description: Percent of the view saturated, e.g. 13.94.
Percent of the view saturated, e.g. 13.94.
Percent of the view saturated, e.g. 13.94.

data_validation.description: EMDB's own file-level validation, where it has been run. Null means NOT RUN, not passed.

map_data_validation.description: One entry per map FILE, keyed by the filename ('emd_1234.map'). The key is data, so read it as a map.

additionalProperties.description: What the validator found for that file.

exists.description: True when the file was found.

valid.description: True when it passed. Measured FALSE on the example entry -- the map exists and does not validate, which `exists` alone would not say.

items.description: One entry. This upstream returns such a list as scalars in some replies and as full records in others, so an element can be either.

error.description: The error, where it failed outright rather than failing validation.

items.description: One entry. This upstream returns such a list as scalars in some replies and as full records in others, so an element can be either.

validation_json.description: The validation report on the record itself -- whether EMDB's own checks passed.

status.description: Whether validation passed. Measured FALSE on the example entry.

errors.description: What failed, e.g. "$: 'map_surface' is a required property" -- the validator saying the record is incomplete. An empty list is the only clean result.

schema_version.description: Version of the validation schema, e.g. '0.0.1.dev137'. A dev version means these verdicts may change.

version.description: Version of the validation pipeline, e.g. '0.0.1.dev137'.
